from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalanceRecord(BaseModel):
    """A cash balance figure extracted from one quarterly financial report."""
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period this balance represents (e.g., '2018年第三季度末', '2019年第一季度末')")
    balance_type: str | None = Field(description="Whether this is beginning or ending balance; 'beginning' or 'ending'")
    cash_balance: float | None = Field(description="Cash and cash equivalents balance amount in yuan")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, typically '元'")
    report_year: str | None = Field(description="Which year's financial report this is from")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt or field name referencing the cash balance")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balance_records: list[CashBalanceRecord]
